description: Vietnam veteran associated with the Battle of Long Tan resupply. Transported to Caloundra by road in 05/2011 and restored by Queensland Air Museum volunteers on behalf of the RSL; mounted on a pole outside the club. Removed from the pole in 2018 to appear in a film about Long Tan, then refurbished and returned to the pole. Identity and current holder confirmed on ADF-Serials. Recorded without a serial: A2-1020 is also claimed for the Iroquois at the RAAF Museum Point Cook and the conflict could not be resolved from open sources.
